introHtml: Custom soccer bar wine sets are a unique promotional item for sports bars, watch parties, and corporate events tied to the beautiful game. These branded wine bottles or glasses let you combine team spirit with a premium giveaway that stands out from standard pint glasses or koozies. Whether you are outfitting a soccer clubhouse or rewarding employees with a match-day toast, screen printing or etching your logo onto these items creates a memorable connection with your audience.
